title: Robert James Coker
clean_html:
Robert James Coker

Preserved Primary Document • coker-r1.htm

Robert J. Coker was the son of Moses Coker and Mary Ann Dean . Robert was born in Kent Co. , DE on 7 September, 1874. He married Nellie Miller and they had the following children: Lawrence Coker Elwood Coker Nellie Coker Robert and his "tall tales" are featured in Weslager's book: "Delaware's forgotten folk" . Robert died sometime after 1957. Nellie died in Chester PA. in June, 1968.
